name: salesraga
description: Bring your SalesRaga CRM into ChatGPT — search and update deals, contacts, companies, tasks, line items and notes, as you.

interface.shortDescription: Your sales CRM, in the chat
interface.longDescription:
Bring your SalesRaga CRM into ChatGPT. Search and update contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and line items — and read a record's full history — without leaving the chat. Create contacts and deals, log notes, move deals through your pipeline, and run quick analytics across your records in seconds.

Useful for pre-call prep, pipeline reviews, daily follow-ups, and full account visibility.

Every action runs as you, scoped to your own SalesRaga permissions — the connector only sees and changes what your user already can, and every write is attributed to you. Read tools are read-only; write tools ask before they change anything.

Connect once with a single OAuth sign-in — no API keys to paste. Permission-aware, real-time, secure.
defaultPrompt: What deals are closing this month and which need attention?
Create a contact and log a follow-up task for them.
Summarize recent activity on my top open deals.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the deal counts grouped by stage (New 8, In-progress 8, Closed Won 6, Closed Lost 3), excluding archived records.

positive.prompt: Show me the deal 'Wayne risk platform'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the deal's full detail — value, stage, custom fields (Lead Source, Priority) and any line items — for the signed-in user's record.

positive.prompt: List the notes on 'Globex plant rollout'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the seeded comments on that deal (e.g. the data-processing addendum / DPO note), newest first.

positive.description: Create a company and a linked contact
positive.prompt: Create a company 'Contoso Ltd' and a contact Jane Doe at it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the company and the contact, links the contact to the company, and confirms both with their names.

positive.prompt: Move 'Wayne API expansion' to Closed Won.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves the deal to the Closed Won stage after disclosing that the write may notify people and trigger automations, then confirms the new stage.

negative.prompt: Create a deal without a pipeline or contact.
Pay this supplier $5,000 from our account.

review.commerce_description: The connector operates CRM records only; it does not sell products or services or process any payment inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and write SalesRaga CRM records (deals, contacts, companies, tasks, notes, line items) via OAuth, scoped to the signed-in user.
